findings.name: Balade en calèche
findings.result: No newly qualified identity, nominal Pokeyland photograph, alias or operation date.
findings.retainedEvidence: The official map photographed in 2017 labels Balade en calèche as no.29; a 2017 nocturne announcement also names it.

newPhotoCandidate.visualObservation: One white horse pulling a black carriage with red wheels and seats, children aboard, on a village street with houses. No identifiable Pokeyland sign.
newPhotoCandidate.articleContext: The Chaudeney youth-club report lists separate excursions to Sainte-Croix, Pokeyland and Madine, then local activities introduced by Sur place including carriage rides.
newPhotoCandidate.articleDateCaution: The URL contains 2025/08/10; the readable article states 6 August 2025 at 12:00. Neither is an exact carriage photograph date.
newPhotoCandidate.decision: Rejected for attribution to Pokeyland. This is not evidence that the park offered a carriage ride in 2025. Whole native retained unchanged, no crop/import.

findings.name: Archery Games / Archery Tag
findings.result: Identity link remains unproved; no newly qualified nominal native photograph.

retainedEvidence.source: Official map photographed by L’Est Républicain
retainedEvidence.finding: ARCHERY GAMES novelty label, separate from target archery and Le Petit Robin.
Archery Tag announced as new, two opposing teams and targets; the same page still lists Archey games in its generic inventory. This does not explicitly establish renaming or replacement.

newlyChecked.source: Familles rurales / Inter C.E.A. 2021 partner booklet, page 39
newlyChecked.finding: Whole advertisement visually inspected. Branded promotional illustration, including a drawn archer, and the phrase 5 nouveautés. No Archery Games/Tag name and no equipment photograph. Not used to describe the place.

newlyChecked.source: Public indexed excerpt for Scribd document 513775350, Pokeyland-BROCHURE-2021-4-2
newlyChecked.finding: Indexed text refers to season 2021 and Archery Tag, with foam-tipped arrows/team game. Previously saved public viewer is a shell, not a recovered full PDF. The uploaded title mentions 2023; that title is not a reliable brochure date. This indexed fragment does not prove Games=Tag or the exact physical field. No access restriction bypassed.

findings.decision: Keep Games/Tag as an unresolved research cluster. Do not create two speculative duplicate places, assert a rename, or substitute Tir à l’arc, Le Petit Robin or Bazooka ball.

findings.name: Historical restaurants and refreshment stands
findings.result: New 2018 dated announcement extends the documented named list but resolves no successor alias.

newEvidence.sourceType: Event announcement, not retrospective proof of actual operation
newEvidence.quote: Restaurants ouverts sur le parc le jour de la nocturne. ( Snack, Pizzeria, le nouveau restaurant O’Chalet, Sur le Pouce et deux buvettes supplémentaires)

chronology.finding: Official map: Buvette Sur le Pouce no.23; O’Chalet (barbecue géant) no.28. Nocturne announcements name O’Chalet and Sur le Pouce.
The July21 announcement names Snack, Pizzeria, O’Chalet, Sur le Pouce and two extra buvettes together.
August14 event announcement names Snack, Pizzeria, O’Chalet, Sur le Pouce and the new L’Escale together.

interpretation: Sur le Pouce, O’Chalet and L’Escale must remain distinct; the 2019 list explicitly juxtaposes them.
New O’Chalet wording in 2018 is already present in 2017: it does not establish an actual 2018 opening.
Snack and Pizzeria are generic labels; no named building photograph or explicit link to a current outlet was found.
Two extra buvettes in an event announcement does not establish two separate permanent services.
O’Chalet’s barbecue function does not prove a rename to Le Grill; no link to Le Petit Creux or Pokey Beach was demonstrated.
The previously preserved printed 2023 brochure announces Pokey Plage with a promotional drawing, not a native outlet photograph. It is already in root evidence, not a new finding.
findings.decision: No duplicate creation or arbitrary alias justified. No detailed final notice drafted.
remaining: Exact continuity to current named outlets

excludedSearchCollisions: MOSL Calèche filter options are navigation, not a Pokeyland offering.
A 2024 Moselle-language contest Archery Tag prize concerns France Aventures Amnéville; separate Pokeyland tickets do not transfer the activity.
Nancy fair carriage/pony offerings concern Écurie du Vermois, not Pokeyland.
Unrelated O’Chalet and Sur le Pouce restaurants, broad newsletters and sitewide category hits excluded.
The 2025 Chaudeney native carriage photograph is not attributable to Pokeyland.

limitations: Public sources only. No contact, login, purchase or bypass.
Search snippets and an inaccessible full brochure were not presented as fully read primary documents.
Absence from a later activity list does not prove closure.
No unverified dimensions, horse count, current status or opening/closure date assigned to Pokeyland items.
